verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an official REST API (dev.pika.art) with a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec, llms.txt, and an MCP server. Nowhere does it mention an official client SDK or library in any language. An OpenAPI document and raw HTTP endpoints are building blocks a developer could use to generate or write a client; they are not a vendor-shipped SDK, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
